messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty page fired — service: inference-eu-prod | alert: high-latency | count: 125 | p95 1.2s | 5xx spike | pd-incident: P12345

Alice (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Starting triage, tagging @carla @devon

Ben: thx. Any customer impact known?

Alice (oncall): Early look: increased latency and some 502s from grpc proxy. Affected routes: /v1/generate (short seq) and embeddings. EU region only, ~30% of requests elevated latency.

Carla: autoscaler reports no scale-up for GPU pool. Scaling events show throttled quota.

Devon: checking capacity. There was a failed node reboot in eu-west-2 earlier, might've reduced available slots.

SRE rotation: Paging second-level in 5m if no progress. @PagerDuty

Alice (oncall): Running quick mitigation: enabling fallback routing to dedicated-fallback-vsmall for non-critical customers. Will also drain suspected node.

Devon: Command to drain pod:
```
kubectl -n redwood-prod drain gpu-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
``` 
Will force a pod move onto healthy node.

Ben: any chance this is batching backlog? queue_depth looks high

Alice (oncall): queue depth metrics:
```
inference.request_queue_depth{region="eu-west-2"}=180
p95_latency_ms=1200
error_rate=6.1%
```

Carla: I just bumped autoscaler min replicas from 4 -> 6 for pool 'gpu-inference-eu', gave permission to create nodes. Monitoring.

IncidentBot: Update posted to PD: P12345 -> acknowledged by Alice (oncall)

Devon: restarted grpc-proxy on node-21, logs show connection_reset by upstream model server. Investigating model server health.

Alice (oncall): model server (m-7b-v2) instances on node-23 were OOMing earlier. We're switching small traffic to m-7b-quant to reduce mem pressure.

Ben: Good call. Any customer-facing errors to report? Should we open a support incident?

Alice (oncall): Tier-1 customers may see 5-10% request failures with retries succeeding. I'll draft a short status note.

Carla: Autoscaler started two new nodes, pods scheduled. p95 dropping to 700ms.

Devon: Confirmed model server restarted and is passing health checks. No more OOM traces in logs.

IncidentBot: PagerDuty escalation suppressed — owner active.

Alice (oncall): Handing off to @Devon for monitoring over next 30m. I'll update runbook and move to follow-up.

Devon: taking ownership. I'll post status pings every 10m. First ping: p95 520ms, errors 1.2%, queue 40. :thumbsup:

Ben: thanks. Could you capture which customers hit failures for postmortem? Need promptset ids.

Devon: will export request ids and attach to ticket P12345.

Alice (oncall): Leaving on-call note: drained node-23, forced restart grpc-proxy, routed non-critical to fallback model, autoscaler increased min replicas. If things reoccur, escalate to infra. Reassigning PD -> Devon.

PagerDuty: PD reassign: P12345 owner -> Devon

Devon: acknowledged PD ownership. continuing monitoring.

IncidentBot: Thread closed for active mitigation, follow-up channel #postmortems/P12345 created.

Carla: follow-up: add quota check to autoscaler runbook. cc @product

Ben: great, thanks team.
